sections.h2: Why chips mislead in Florida light
body: Strong North Florida sun washes out colors on a south-facing wall, and the same color can look gray and heavy on a shaded porch. Indoors, light from big windows reads differently in the morning than at dusk. A two-inch chip can't show you any of that. A color consultation in Lake City, FL starts with large full-size drawdowns placed on the walls you are actually painting, so you see the color in your own light before any product is ordered.

sections.h2: Three kinds of Lake City color decisions
body: Historic homes near downtown often look best with colors that suit their age and trim details, with the body, trim, and door colors working together. Our article on historic paint colors was written for Gainesville's older homes, but the same thinking applies to downtown Lake City.

Homes in subdivisions may have association color rules. We build the approved palette into the scope before anything is ordered. Storefronts have to be readable from the road and fit the business's brand colors, which matters along the busy corridors near the I-75 and I-10 crossroads. We look at signage, awnings, and the materials next door so the building stands out without clashing.

faqs.q: Can you help pick colors that meet my HOA's rules in Lake City?
faqs.a: Yes. We work from your association's approved palette and build those colors into the written scope before ordering product.

faqs.q: Why use drawdowns instead of paint chips?
faqs.a: A full-size drawdown shows how the color looks in your light and at the scale of a wall. A small chip can look very different once it is on the house.

faqs.q: Can you match a color if I don't have the can label?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a chip, a cabinet door, or a leftover can and confirm it with a drawdown.

faqs.q: Should exterior and interior colors be chosen together?
faqs.a: It helps. The front door, porch ceiling, and entry walls are seen together, so we usually coordinate them in one session and write the full palette into the estimate.
